Version 1.0.8 improves repeated Preview/Run workflows, large track-table responsiveness, and progress visibility.

- Tracks from Preview remain visible while Run is active instead of disappearing.
- Checking or unchecking one track updates only that row, avoiding a full table rebuild on large releases.
- Audio Sync delay and timeline-shift lines stand out in the Summary with a dedicated accent color.
- Workflow progress is mirrored on the Windows taskbar when the active shell exposes `ITaskbarList3`.
- Packaged builds include a modern Windows compatibility manifest and stable AppUserModelID.
